{{Quote|You need to find one of the Singing Mountain Clan Sisters and take the stone from her headdress.|Xarot Korlin, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:XK">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=static|Xarot Korlin|Dathomir}}</ref>}}
A '''Singing Mountain Clan Force Crystal''' was a [[Force crystal|crystal]] native to [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. Members of the [[Singing Mountain Clan]] wore it as part of their elaborate [[Clothing/Legends|headdresses]]. [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Imperial Inquisitor]] [[Xarot Korlin]], who had been studying [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], sent an agent to [[Death/Legends|kill]] one of them to obtain one of these [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] for his studies. The agent noticed that the crystal was warm to the touch. The agent also felt at ease having it on their person.<ref name="SWG:XK" />

==Behind the scenes==
This crystal was an item in [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']] that was available through a quest for Imperial Inquisitor Xarot Korlin. By killing a Singing Mountain Clan members, collecting the crystal and then deleting the quest, players were able to retain the crystal for themselves.<ref name="SWG:XK" /> The crystals had no Force-enhancing effect, but instead could be used as a decoration for players' houses.<ref name="SWG:NFC">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=item|Singing Mountain Clan Force Crystal}}</ref>
